narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Nagesh is in row three, so his range is three B to three G.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>A cell name starts with the column letter, and three B starts with the row.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A sheet would not read three B as a cell, so the letter must come first.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To name a cell, say the column letter, then the row number.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>To name a range, write the first cell, a colon, then the last cell.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Meera's marks sit in row seven, from column C to column H. Write them as a range.
